content: What is found now is found then. If you find nothing now, you will simply end up with an apartment in the city of death.
author: Kabir
explanation: Kabir strips away comforting postponements of spiritual realization to after death. Liberation, peace, and truth must be realized right now in mortal flesh, or posthumous promises mean nothing.
practicalInsight: Bring supreme attention to your present living hour. Do not postpone ethical integrity, inner peace, or love to a hypothetical retirement or afterlife.
reflectionPrompt: What essential truth or forgiveness am I lazily deferring to the future?
